#!/usr/bin/env python3

import os
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime

def check_certificate():
    cert_path = "/app/ssl/server.crt"

    # Verify certificate exists
    if not os.path.exists(cert_path):
        print(f"Error: Certificate file not found at {cert_path}")
        return False

    try:
        # Load and parse certificate using openssl
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-noout", "-text"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )

        # Extract Common Name
        cn_result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-noout", "-subject"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )
        subject_line = cn_result.stdout.strip()
        # Extract CN from "subject=O = DevOps Team, CN = dev-internal.company.local"
        cn = None
        for part in subject_line.split("subject=")[1].split(","):
            if "CN" in part:
                cn = part.split("=")[1].strip()
                break

        # Extract expiration date
        dates_result = subprocess.run(
            ["openssl", "x509", "-in", cert_path, "-noout", "-dates"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True
        )

        # Parse notAfter date and convert to YYYY-MM-DD format
        for line in dates_result.stdout.split("\n"):
            if "notAfter" in line:
                date_str = line.split("=")[1].strip()
                # Parse OpenSSL date format: "Sep  4 18:28:13 2027 GMT"
                date_obj = datetime.strptime(date_str.split(" GMT")[0], "%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y")
                expiration_date = date_obj.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        print(f"Certificate Details:")
        print(f"Common Name: {cn}")
        print(f"Expiration Date: {expiration_date}")
        print("Certificate verification successful")
        return True

    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error: Failed to load certificate: {e.stderr}")
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
        return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    success = check_certificate()
    exit(0 if success else 1)
